split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="and a Majority of each shall constitute a Quorum to do Business"
decision_basis: The House's authority to judge elections, returns, and qualifications is textually distinct from the majority-quorum requirement.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="and may be authorized to compel the Attendance of absent Members"
decision_basis: Adjournment by a smaller number and authority to compel absent Members are independently stated powers.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="punish its Members for disorderly Behaviour"; SPLIT-BEFORE="and, with the Concurrence of two thirds, expel a Member"
decision_basis: Rulemaking, punishment for disorderly behavior, and expulsion subject to a two-thirds concurrence threshold are separately testable propositions.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="and from time to time publish the same"
decision_basis: The duty to keep a Journal and the duty to publish it, subject to the textual secrecy exception, are distinct requirements.
The candidate states one integrated requirement for recording Yeas and Nays upon the stated one-fifth request threshold.
The candidate states one integrated inter-House consent limitation on adjournment duration and location.
The compensation entitlement together with legal ascertainment and Treasury payment conditions forms one integrated provision.
The candidate states the privilege from arrest together with its express exceptions and temporal scope.
The candidate states the Speech or Debate protection as one proposition.
The candidate states one integrated prohibition on appointment to specified civil offices during the elected term.
The candidate states one incompatibility prohibition on simultaneous federal officeholding and congressional membership.
The candidate states the House-origination requirement for revenue bills.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="Every Bill which shall have passed the House of Representatives and the Senate"
decision_basis: The Senate's authority to propose or concur in amendments to revenue bills is distinct from the general presidential-presentment requirement for bills passed by both Houses.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="but if not he shall return it"; SPLIT-BEFORE="who shall enter the Objections at large on their Journal"; SPLIT-BEFORE="and proceed to reconsider it"
decision_basis: Presidential approval, presidential return with objections, journal entry of objections, and reconsideration are separately stated procedural requirements.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="and if approved by two thirds of that House"
decision_basis: The first-House reconsideration and transmission sequence is distinguishable from the second-House two-thirds approval condition producing law.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="and the Names of the Persons voting for and against the Bill shall be entered"; SPLIT-BEFORE="If any Bill shall not be returned by the President"; SPLIT-BEFORE="Every Order, Resolution, or Vote to which the Concurrence of the Senate and House of Representatives may be necessary"
decision_basis: The candidate contains distinct vote-recording requirements, the ten-day return/default-law rule with its adjournment exception, and the presentment requirement for qualifying orders, resolutions, and votes.
Presidential approval or two-thirds repassage are alternative effect conditions within one integrated presentment rule.
The taxing power and its stated debt, common-defense, and general-welfare purposes form one integrated enumerated grant.
The candidate states the geographic uniformity requirement for Duties, Imposts, and Excises.
The candidate states the borrowing power as one proposition.
The candidate states one commerce-regulation grant across its three expressly listed domains.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="and uniform Laws on the subject of Bankruptcies"
decision_basis: The naturalization rule and bankruptcy-law authority are separately stated enumerated powers.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="regulate the Value thereof"; SPLIT-BEFORE="and fix the Standard of Weights and Measures"
decision_basis: Coinage, regulation of monetary value, and establishment of weights-and-measures standards are separately testable grants.
The candidate states one power to provide punishment for counterfeiting the listed federal securities and coin.
Post Offices and post Roads are expressed together under one establishment power.
The progress-of-science-and-arts objective and limited exclusive-right mechanism form one integrated grant.
The candidate states the power to constitute inferior tribunals.
The listed piracy, high-seas felony, and law-of-nations offenses appear within one define-and-punish grant.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="grant Letters of Marque and Reprisal"; SPLIT-BEFORE="and make Rules concerning Captures on Land and Water"
decision_basis: Declaration of war, Letters of Marque and Reprisal, and rules concerning captures are separately stated powers.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="but no Appropriation of Money to that Use shall be for a longer Term than two Years"
decision_basis: The power to raise and support Armies is textually distinct from the two-year limitation on appropriations for that use.
The candidate states the Navy provision as one grant.
The candidate states one rulemaking power governing the land and naval forces.
Calling forth the Militia is stated as one grant with three enumerated purposes.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="and for governing such Part of them as may be employed in the Service of the United States"; SPLIT-BEFORE="reserving to the States respectively, the Appointment of the Officers"; SPLIT-BEFORE="and the Authority of training the Militia"
decision_basis: Militia organization and discipline, federal governance of militia in federal service, state officer-appointment authority, and state training authority are distinct textual propositions.

split_specification: SPLIT-BEFORE="and to exercise like Authority over all Places purchased by the Consent of the Legislature of the State"
decision_basis: Exclusive legislation over the federal district and like authority over federally acquired sites subject to state consent are separately conditioned grants.
The Necessary and Proper provision states one integrated implementing-law power tied to constitutionally vested powers.
